message.subject: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Thank you for reviewing the price and payment options with us. We appreciate your team's review.

For your review, AS-14404 changed by -5.49% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). We recognise that this recent movement can coexist with the annual increase you described. Could you take it into account when reviewing the starting price?

Could we agree the following complete compromise? EUR 5.09/kg, payment within 45 days net, a 36-month contract, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband and base month 2026-08.

The price is conditional on this payment term and the complete package. This is a new proposal for your approval. The fixed terms of our enquiry remain unchanged. Could your authorised colleague issue this package as your binding offer?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
